stem.text: A student sets up an experiment to investigate double-slit interference.
The student uses light of a single wavelength from a laser to illuminate a double slit so that a pattern of interference fringes is observed on the screen.

stem.alt: Laser box emitting light towards a double slit, with the distance from the laser to the slit labelled p and the slit separation labelled r. The distance from the double slit to the screen is labelled q. Labels: laser; double slit; fringes observed here; screen.

stem.text: The student finds that the fringes are very close together.
What could the student **decrease** in order to increase the separation of the fringes on the screen?

A.text: the distance $p$ from the laser to the double slit

B.text: the distance $q$ from the double slit to the screen

D.text: the wavelength of the light from the laser
